purpose: Define the LuHmOS package's four-layer composition model for core, extensions, organization, and typed adapters.
namingLaw: Project-owned package and extension names use LuHmOS. The previous jQuery-named Doctrine file is historical evidence and is not the current naming authority.

layers.title: Core Library
layers.purpose: small stable primitives, data contracts, shared helpers, naming law, source identity, evidence law, and deterministic base behavior

layers.title: LuHmOS Plugin Extension
layers.purpose: bounded domain features that extend the package core without rewriting it

layers.title: Class and Widget Organization
layers.purpose: compose extensions into human-understandable agents, rooms, cabinets, widgets, workflows, and reusable organizational roles

layers.title: Stub and Adapter Boundary
layers.purpose: expose the organized system through thin typed interfaces to providers, ChatGPT, Android, Godot, shell/build tools, and external services without leaking authority inward

relationToEscalation: architecture layers describe composition; escalation tiers describe operational depth; both use the same zero-based four-count for cognitive consistency
